# Eight-slot repository growth runner preparation

This package prepares the previously frozen growth pilot for a possible future
execution. **No model calls are authorized by this package.** It contains no
authorization file, credential, submitted job, accepted model parent or live
stage-two payload. Root must finish independent source review before constructing
`runtime-freeze.json`; a separate explicit human decision is needed before any
paid execution.

The maximum is eight fresh requests: two independent lineages for each of
Dafny-VMC and Vest, with at most two sequential additions per lineage. One
response is allowed per stage, with no retry or feedback repair loop. An ordinary
proof or edit-guard rejection is an evaluated failed stage; its child is blocked
without reassignment. API ambiguity, integrity drift or unresolved native
execution stops future dispatch. Eight is a ceiling, not a target to fill.

The immutable pilot remains the authority for prompts, model/settings, order,
contracts, output grammar and stage-two rendering. Child prompts require the
actual accepted first addition and its source-bound native receipt. Analyst
reference/control artifacts are host-side qualification evidence only; they are
not model context or accepted model parents. Synthetic test fixtures are included
only for explicit offline tests and must never enter live dispatch.

`build_runtime.py inspect` resolves an explicit repository-relative input
inventory without writing a freeze. After root review, `freeze` creates the new
runtime manifest exclusively and refuses an existing manifest. No unrestricted
repository scan selects credentials, live ledgers or output directories. The
qualified upstream snapshots, proposal, policy, saved evidence, native closure
and execution sources are hash-bound. Existing cluster images and toolchains
remain at their qualified paths; the native host checks their exact hashes.

The remote layout is
`~/formal-disco/outputs/real-repository-growth-001/execution-001/`, with exact
repository paths under `repo/`, a mirrored runtime manifest and `run.sbatch`, and
fresh output in `model-001/`. A supplied authorization is copied verbatim to
`authorization.json`; ops never manufactures approval. It must name Sophie Zeng,
state the explicit human approval basis, bind this runtime and pilot, cap new
requests at eight, prohibit retries/reassignment, and expire within 24 hours.

Ops uses only authenticated socket 21 (or an explicitly supplied socket path),
batch mode, disabled fallback transport and hard subprocess timeouts. Submission
requires a passing fake-only remote preflight, fresh output/submission/ledger
state (including the exclusive execution claim), the authorization, private handoff metadata, and a live `shared` partition
check showing `PreemptMode=OFF`, `State=UP` and at least four hours. Handoff
contents are never read, hashed or printed by ops. Exclusive local intent and
remote lock survive failed or ambiguous submission; there is no retry/resume
operation. Older paid ledgers and results remain unchanged.

The job requests one node, one task, **one CPU, 8 GB and four hours**, with no
requeue. Dafny remains fixed at resource limit 100,000 and a 300-second native
wall cap; Vest uses one Cargo worker, one Verus thread and a 900-second native
wall cap. Up to four invocations of each native backend plus eight 180-second
provider reads account for 6,240 seconds before build/setup overhead. The Slurm
bound is fixed, not an adaptive escalation; the short `test` partition is not
assumed to support it.

Preflight runs only the new fake transport/native tests and `bash -n`. Remote
preflight additionally requires boto3/botocore imports, records their observed
versions, and constructs a `Config` with 15-second connect/180-second read limits
and one total SDK attempt. Local preflight reports an absent SDK without treating
it as a provider check; `--require-sdk` makes imports mandatory. No client is
constructed, and no verifier is called. Logs preserve code hashes,
test output and draft/frozen status. A relocated manifest-only package must also
pass preflight before staging is released.

After a terminal job, fetch requires exactly one parent accounting row and
explicit terminal states for every relevant step. Similar-prefix IDs do not
substitute for the parent; suspended, stopped, unknown or live steps fail closed.
Before either endpoint is changed, a read-only regular-file inventory and local
free-space check reserve the full transfer plus headroom. Source bytes, responses,
request ledger, accepted records, native stdout/stderr, CSV/JSON, resource reports
and failures are preserved. Only the eight exact generated
`slot-NN/native/fresh-target` Cargo target directories are excluded, using the
same enumerator as the run's archive manifest; all native source workspaces
remain included. No scratch files are deleted. Raw native failures remain failures even if a later,
separately versioned diagnostic succeeds.

Preparation entry points (for root after review):

```text
python -B build_runtime.py inspect
python -B preflight.py --draft
python -B build_runtime.py freeze
python -B ops.py stage
python -B ops.py preflight
python -B ops.py submit --authorization /path/to/explicit-reviewed-authorization.json
python -B ops.py status
python -B ops.py fetch
```

Only preparation and offline tests are in the current authorized scope. Listing
future commands does not authorize their execution.

"""Explicit, single-submission controls for the unapproved eight-slot proposal.

This module does not create authorization. Handoff content is never read here.
All transport calls have hard timeouts and use only an authenticated shared socket.
"""
import argparse
import datetime
import hashlib
import io
import json
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import re
import shlex
import shutil
import stat
import subprocess
import sys
import tarfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
REPO = ROOT.parents[2]
REL = "experiments/real-repository-growth-001/execution-001"
REMOTE_SUFFIX = "formal-disco/outputs/real-repository-growth-001/execution-001"
SOCKET = Path.home() / ".ssh/repodisco-codex-21.sock"
HOST = "sophiezeng@login.rc.fas.harvard.edu"
JOB_NAME = "growth-model-8-001"
JOB_SECONDS = 14400


def require(value, message):
    if not value:
        raise ValueError(message)


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def read(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_bytes())


def save(path, data):
    path = Path(path)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with path.open("xb") as stream:
        stream.write(data)


def write(path, value):
    save(path, (json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode())


def validate_package():
    import runtime
    return runtime.validate_package(REPO)


def validate_authorization(path):
    import runtime
    return runtime.validate_authorization(Path(path), REPO)


def fresh_execution(root, *, forbid_authorization=True):
    root = Path(root)
    for name in ("model-001", "startup-failure.json", "execution.claim.json"):
        require(not (root / name).exists() and not (root / name).is_symlink(), "Existing output: inspect; never restart")
    require(not list((root / "submissions").glob("model.*")), "Existing submission/intention: never resubmit")
    require(not list(root.glob("*ledger*")), "Existing ledger: never reuse or reassign")
    if forbid_authorization:
        require(not (root / "authorization.json").exists(), "Existing remote authorization: inspect; never overwrite")


def private_handoff_metadata(path):
    """lstat only; deliberately never open/read/hash the credential."""
    path = Path(path)
    info = path.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) and not stat.S_ISLNK(info.st_mode), "Handoff must be a regular private file")
    import os
    require(info.st_uid == os.getuid() and stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) == 0o600,
            "Handoff owner/permissions differ")
    require(0 < info.st_size <= 65536, "Handoff metadata size invalid")
    return dict(regular_file=True, owner_uid=info.st_uid, permissions="0600", bytes=info.st_size,
                content_read=False)


def partition_seconds(text):
    values = dict(re.findall(r"(?:^|\s)([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*)=(\S+)", text))
    require(values.get("PartitionName") == "shared" and values.get("PreemptMode") == "OFF" and
            values.get("State") == "UP", "Shared partition is not live-confirmed nonpreemptible/UP")
    maximum = values.get("MaxTime", "")
    if maximum == "UNLIMITED":
        return None
    match = re.fullmatch(r"(?:(\d+)-)?(\d+):(\d{2}):(\d{2})", maximum)
    require(match is not None, "Unknown partition time limit")
    days, hours, minutes, seconds = (int(x or 0) for x in match.groups())
    require(minutes < 60 and seconds < 60, "Malformed partition time limit")
    total = ((days * 24 + hours) * 60 + minutes) * 60 + seconds
    require(total >= JOB_SECONDS, "Shared partition cannot fit the fixed four-hour request")
    return total


def no_matching_queue(queue, root):
    for line in queue.splitlines():
        fields = line.split("|")
        require(len(fields) == 4, "Malformed queue listing")
        require(fields[1] != str(root) and fields[2] != JOB_NAME, "Matching execution job already queued")

# An archive is final even when the native command failed. Only these explicit
# terminal Slurm base states permit it; live, requeue/held and unknown states do not.
TERMINAL_STATES=frozenset(('BOOT_FAIL','CANCELLED','COMPLETED','DEADLINE','FAILED',
                          'NODE_FAIL','OUT_OF_MEMORY','PREEMPTED','REVOKED','TIMEOUT'))
ACCOUNTING_FIELDS=('JobID','State','Elapsed','ElapsedRaw','ExitCode','AllocCPUS',
                   'TotalCPU','CPUTimeRAW','MaxRSS','NodeList')

def terminal_accounting(accounting,job):
    """Require one exact parent and terminal states for every returned step.

    A trailing '+' is Slurm's display-truncation marker; it is removable only
    when the remaining complete base state is known. The normal CANCELLED
    'by <numeric uid>' suffix is descriptive. An abbreviated base such as
    'OUT_OF_ME+' remains unknown and is rejected, never guessed.
    """
    require(isinstance(job,str) and re.fullmatch(r'[1-9][0-9]*',job),'Invalid parent JobID')
    require(isinstance(accounting,str),'Accounting must be decoded text')
    lines=[line for line in accounting.splitlines() if line.strip()]
    require(lines and tuple(x.strip() for x in lines[0].split('|'))==ACCOUNTING_FIELDS,
              'Unexpected accounting header')
    rows=[];seen=set();ignored=[]
    for line in lines[1:]:
        values=[x.strip() for x in line.split('|')]
        require(len(values)==len(ACCOUNTING_FIELDS),'Malformed accounting row')
        row=dict(zip(ACCOUNTING_FIELDS,values));ident=row['JobID']
        require(bool(ident),'Missing accounting JobID')
        if ident!=job and not ident.startswith(job+'.'):
            ignored.append(ident);continue
        if ident!=job:
            require(re.fullmatch(re.escape(job)+r'\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+',ident),
                      'Malformed relevant step JobID')
        require(ident not in seen,'Duplicate parent or step accounting row')
        seen.add(ident);state=row['State']
        if state.endswith('+'):state=state[:-1].rstrip()
        match=re.fullmatch(r'([A-Z_]+)(?: by ([0-9]+))?',state)
        require(match is not None and (match.group(2) is None or match.group(1)=='CANCELLED'),
                  'Unknown accounting state syntax for '+ident)
        base=match.group(1)
        require(base in TERMINAL_STATES,'Nonterminal or unknown accounting state for '+ident+': '+row['State'])
        rows.append(dict(job_id=ident,state=row['State'],normalized_state=base,
                         kind='parent' if ident==job else 'step'))
    require(sum(row['job_id']==job for row in rows)==1,'Missing exact parent accounting row')
    return dict(parent_job_id=job,rows=rows,ignored_job_ids=ignored,all_relevant_rows_terminal=True,
                accounting_sha256=hashlib.sha256(accounting.encode()).hexdigest())


CHECK = r'''import hashlib,json,sys
expected=EXPECTED_RUNTIME
repo=root/'repo'
code=repo/'experiments/real-repository-growth-001/execution-001'
assert hashlib.sha256((root/'runtime-freeze.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()==expected
assert (root/'runtime-freeze.json').read_bytes()==(code/'runtime-freeze.json').read_bytes()
freeze=json.loads((root/'runtime-freeze.json').read_bytes())
assert freeze['schema']=='repodisco-growth-execution-runtime-v1'
from pathlib import PurePosixPath
for name,digest in freeze['repo_files'].items():
 p=PurePosixPath(name)
 assert not p.is_absolute() and '..' not in p.parts and '\\' not in name
 target=repo/name;current=target
 while current!=repo:
  assert not current.is_symlink(),name
  current=current.parent
 assert target.is_file() and hashlib.sha256(target.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest,name
assert (root/'run.sbatch').read_bytes()==(code/'run.sbatch').read_bytes()
sys.path.insert(0,str(code))
'''


def remote(code, data=None, seconds=45, socket=SOCKET):
    socket = Path(socket)
    require(socket.is_absolute() and "\x00" not in str(socket), "Absolute authenticated socket path required")
    argv = ['ssh', '-S', str(socket), '-o', 'BatchMode=yes', '-o', 'ConnectTimeout=8',
            '-o', 'ProxyCommand=false', HOST]
    prefix = "from pathlib import Path\nroot=Path.home()/" + repr(REMOTE_SUFFIX) + "\n"
    code = code.replace('EXPECTED_RUNTIME', repr(sha(ROOT / 'runtime-freeze.json')))
    result = subprocess.run(argv + ['python3 -c ' + shlex.quote(prefix + code)], input=data,
                            stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=seconds)
    if result.stderr:
        print(result.stderr.decode(errors='replace'), file=sys.stderr)
    result.check_returncode()
    return result.stdout


def stage(socket=SOCKET):
    """After explicit root release, stage exact nonsecret package once."""
    validate_package()
    require(not any((ROOT / name).exists() for name in ('stage-001.json', 'stage.intent.json')),
            'Existing staging state: inspect; never restage')
    freeze = read(ROOT / 'runtime-freeze.json')
    archive = io.BytesIO()
    with tarfile.open(fileobj=archive, mode='w:gz') as tar:
        for name in sorted(freeze['repo_files']):
            tar.add(REPO / name, arcname='repo/' + name, recursive=False)
        for name, destination in [('runtime-freeze.json', 'runtime-freeze.json'),
                                  ('runtime-freeze.json', 'repo/' + REL + '/runtime-freeze.json'),
                                  ('run.sbatch', 'run.sbatch')]:
            tar.add(ROOT / name, arcname=destination, recursive=False)
    write(ROOT / 'stage.intent.json', dict(runtime_sha256=sha(ROOT / 'runtime-freeze.json'),
                                         model_calls=0, native_calls=0, no_retry=True))
    program = r'''import io,tarfile,sys,json
from pathlib import PurePosixPath
assert not root.exists(),'Destination exists: inspect; never restage'
data=sys.stdin.buffer.read()
with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(data),mode='r:gz') as tar:
 names=set()
 for member in tar.getmembers():
  path=PurePosixPath(member.name)
  assert member.isfile() and not path.is_absolute() and '..' not in path.parts and '\\' not in member.name
  assert member.name not in names
  names.add(member.name)
 root.mkdir(parents=True)
 for member in tar.getmembers():
  target=root/member.name;target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
  with target.open('xb') as stream:stream.write(tar.extractfile(member).read())
'''+CHECK+r'''
print(json.dumps(dict(root=str(root),runtime_sha256=expected,model_calls=0,native_calls=0)))
'''
    raw = remote(program, archive.getvalue(), seconds=180, socket=socket)
    save(ROOT / 'stage-001.json', raw)
    print(raw.decode())


def preflight(socket=SOCKET):
    require(not (ROOT / 'remote-preflight-001.json').exists(), 'Remote preflight already recorded')
    program = CHECK+r'''import subprocess
assert not (root/'remote-preflight-001.json').exists(),'Remote preflight already recorded'
process=subprocess.run([str(Path.home()/'.conda/envs/repodisco/bin/python'),'-B',str(code/'preflight.py'),
                       '--repo',str(repo),'--require-sdk'],cwd=str(code),stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,timeout=240)
try:
 result=json.loads(process.stdout.decode())
 assert result['returncode']==process.returncode
except (ValueError,KeyError,AssertionError):
 result=dict(returncode=process.returncode or 1,process_returncode=process.returncode,
  log=process.stdout.decode(errors='replace'),preflight_record_parse_failed=True,runtime_sha256=expected,
  model_calls=0,native_calls=0)
result['driver_stderr']=process.stderr.decode(errors='replace')
with (root/'remote-preflight-001.json').open('x') as stream:json.dump(result,stream,indent=2)
print(json.dumps(result))
'''
    raw = remote(program, seconds=250, socket=socket)
    save(ROOT / 'remote-preflight-001.json', raw)
    result = json.loads(raw)
    print(result['log'])
    require(result['returncode'] == 0, 'Remote fake-only preflight failed')


SUBMIT = CHECK+r'''import datetime,os,re,subprocess
import runtime
from ops import fresh_execution,private_handoff_metadata,partition_seconds,no_matching_queue
runtime.validate_package(repo)
fresh_execution(root)
pre=json.loads((root/'remote-preflight-001.json').read_bytes())
assert pre['returncode']==0 and pre['runtime_sha256']==expected
assert pre['sdk']['required'] is True and pre['sdk']['installed'] is True and pre['sdk']['client_created'] is False
assert pre['sdk']['config']==dict(connect_timeout=15,read_timeout=180,retries=dict(mode='standard',total_max_attempts=1))
raw_authorization=sys.stdin.buffer.read()
# This is a verbatim copy of an explicit human authorization supplied to ops,
# not construction of an authorization from a prior or inferred budget.
with (root/'authorization.json').open('xb') as stream:stream.write(raw_authorization)
authorization=runtime.validate_authorization(root/'authorization.json',repo)
assert authorization['authorized_runtime_root']==str(root)
assert repo.parent==root and authorization['output_relative_path']=='model-001'
handoff=private_handoff_metadata(Path.home()/'.repodisco-bedrock-handoff')
queue=subprocess.check_output(['squeue','-u','sophiezeng','-h','-o','%i|%Z|%j|%T'],text=True,timeout=15)
no_matching_queue(queue,root)
partition=subprocess.check_output(['scontrol','show','partition','shared'],text=True,timeout=15)
maximum=partition_seconds(partition)
record=dict(schema='repodisco-growth-exclusive-submission-v1',
 utc=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),runtime_sha256=expected,
 authorization_sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw_authorization).hexdigest(),
 partition='shared',partition_record=partition,prior_queue=queue,
 resources=dict(cpus=1,memory_gb=8,job_seconds=14400,no_requeue=True),
 handoff_metadata=handoff,submission_attempts=1,automatic_retry=False)
sub=root/'submissions';sub.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
with (sub/'model.lock').open('x') as stream:json.dump(record,stream,indent=2)
try:
 process=subprocess.run(['sbatch','--parsable','--partition=shared','run.sbatch'],cwd=str(root),
     stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True,timeout=25)
 record.update(returncode=process.returncode,stdout=process.stdout,stderr=process.stderr)
 if process.returncode==0:
  match=re.fullmatch(r'([1-9][0-9]*)(?:;[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+)?\s*',process.stdout)
  if match:record['job_id']=match.group(1)
  else:record['ambiguous_submission']=True
except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
 record['ambiguous_submission']=True
 record['error_type']='TimeoutExpired'
with (sub/'model.json').open('x') as stream:json.dump(record,stream,indent=2)
print(json.dumps(record))
'''


def submit(authorization, socket=SOCKET):
    """Exactly one attempt, only after separately supplied fresh authorization."""
    validate_package()
    authorization = Path(authorization)
    validate_authorization(authorization)  # before transport or local intent
    raw_authorization = authorization.read_bytes()
    fresh_execution(ROOT, forbid_authorization=False)
    sub = ROOT / 'submissions'
    write(sub / 'model.intent.json', dict(runtime_sha256=sha(ROOT / 'runtime-freeze.json'),
          authorization_sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw_authorization).hexdigest(),
          utc=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(), maximum_submission_attempts=1,
          retries=False, state='INTENT_REQUIRES_READ_ONLY_REVIEW_IF_NO_RECEIPT'))
    try:
        raw = remote(SUBMIT, raw_authorization, seconds=100, socket=socket)
    except BaseException as error:
        write(sub / 'model.transport-failure.json', dict(type=type(error).__name__,
              submission_outcome_requires_read_only_review=True, automatic_retry=False))
        raise
    save(sub / 'model.json', raw)
    record = json.loads(raw)
    print(json.dumps({key: value for key, value in record.items() if key not in ('partition_record', 'prior_queue')}, indent=2))
    require('job_id' in record and not record.get('ambiguous_submission'),
            'Submission failed or ambiguous; preserve intent and do not retry')


def status(socket=SOCKET):
    job = read(ROOT / 'submissions/model.json')['job_id']
    require(re.fullmatch(r'[1-9][0-9]*', job), 'Invalid submission JobID')
    program = 'job=' + repr(job) + '\n' + r'''import subprocess,json
result=dict(accounting=subprocess.check_output(['sacct','-j',job,'--format=JobID,State,Elapsed,ExitCode,NodeList','-P'],text=True,timeout=15))
folder=root/'model-001'
result['model_output_exists']=folder.exists()
result['startup_failure_exists']=(root/'startup-failure.json').exists()
result['completed_records']=len(list(folder.glob('*/result.json')))
result['terminal_records']=[p.name for p in folder.glob('*.json') if p.name in ('complete.json','stopped.json','summary.json')]
print(json.dumps(result))
'''
    print(remote(program, seconds=30, socket=socket).decode())


def transfer_inventory(root, job, accounting, terminal_review):
    """Read-only regular-file inventory of results, never the credential."""
    root = Path(root)
    names = ['submissions/model.lock', 'submissions/model.json', 'authorization.json',
             'runtime-freeze.json', 'remote-preflight-001.json']
    require(all((root / name).is_file() for name in names), 'Missing submission/authorization/provenance evidence')
    # A native/startup failure can precede model-001. Preserve exactly what exists.
    for name in ('startup-failure.json', 'execution.claim.json'):
        if (root / name).exists():
            names.append(name)
    if (root / 'model-001').exists():
        import runtime
        require((root / 'model-001').is_dir() and not (root / 'model-001').is_symlink(), 'Nonregular model evidence root')
        names += [path.relative_to(root).as_posix() for path in runtime.archive_files(root / 'model-001')]
        if (root / 'model-001/archive-manifest.json').exists():
            names.append('model-001/archive-manifest.json')
    names += sorted(path.name for path in root.glob('growth-' + job + '.*'))
    require(any(name.startswith('model-001/') or name == 'startup-failure.json' or name.startswith('growth-') for name in names),
            'No run or scheduler evidence exists')
    inventory = {}

    def visit(path):
        mode = path.lstat().st_mode
        require(not stat.S_ISLNK(mode), 'Symlink in transfer evidence')
        if stat.S_ISDIR(mode):
            for child in sorted(path.iterdir()):
                visit(child)
        else:
            require(stat.S_ISREG(mode), 'Nonregular transfer evidence')
            data = path.read_bytes()
            inventory[path.relative_to(root).as_posix()] = dict(bytes=len(data), sha256=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest())
    for name in names:
        visit(root / name)
    virtual = {'accounting.txt': accounting.encode(),
               'accounting-review.json': json.dumps(terminal_review, indent=2, sort_keys=True).encode()}
    for name, data in virtual.items():
        require(not (root / name).exists(), 'Accounting/archive already created: inspect; never refetch')
        inventory[name] = dict(bytes=len(data), sha256=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest())
    return dict(source_bytes=sum(value['bytes'] for value in inventory.values()), regular_files=len(inventory),
                inventory_sha256=hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(inventory, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')).encode()).hexdigest(),
                names=sorted(inventory), job_id=job,
                excluded_scratch_directories=['model-001/slot-%02d/native/fresh-target' % index
                    for index in range(1, 9) if (root / ('model-001/slot-%02d/native/fresh-target' % index)).exists()],
                exclusions_reason='Exact generated Cargo targets only; all source workspaces and native evidence retained')


def require_fetch_space(estimate, destination):
    size, count = estimate['source_bytes'], estimate['regular_files']
    require(type(size) is int and size >= 0 and type(count) is int and count > 0, 'Invalid transfer size estimate')
    headroom = max(64 * 1024 * 1024, (size + 3) // 4)
    available = shutil.disk_usage(destination).free
    require(available >= size + headroom,
            'Insufficient local disk space before fetch; neither endpoint was changed')
    return dict(source_bytes=size, headroom_bytes=headroom, required_free_bytes=size + headroom, observed_free_bytes=available)


def fetch(socket=SOCKET):
    require(not (ROOT / 'transfer-001.json').exists(), 'Already fetched')
    destination = ROOT / 'retrieved-001'
    require(not destination.exists(), 'Existing local evidence: never partially refetch')
    job = read(ROOT / 'submissions/model.json')['job_id']
    require(re.fullmatch(r'[1-9][0-9]*', job), 'Invalid submission JobID')
    inspect = CHECK + 'job=' + repr(job) + '\n' + r'''import subprocess,json,io,tarfile
from ops import terminal_accounting,transfer_inventory
accounting=subprocess.check_output(['sacct','-j',job,'--format=JobID%40,State%80,Elapsed,ElapsedRaw,ExitCode,AllocCPUS,TotalCPU,CPUTimeRAW,MaxRSS,NodeList','-P'],text=True,timeout=15)
terminal_review=terminal_accounting(accounting,job)
inventory=transfer_inventory(root,job,accounting,terminal_review)
'''
    estimate = json.loads(remote(inspect + 'print(json.dumps(inventory))\n', seconds=90, socket=socket))
    require(estimate['job_id'] == job, 'Transfer estimate identity differs')
    disk = require_fetch_space(estimate, ROOT)
    raw = remote(inspect + 'assert inventory==' + repr(estimate) + ',"Transfer evidence changed after size estimate"\n' + r'''
with (root/'accounting.txt').open('x') as stream:stream.write(accounting)
with (root/'accounting-review.json').open('x') as stream:json.dump(terminal_review,stream,indent=2,sort_keys=True)
buffer=io.BytesIO()
with tarfile.open(fileobj=buffer,mode='w:gz') as tar:
 for name in inventory['names']:tar.add(root/name,arcname=name,recursive=False)

    sizes = {}
    with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(raw), mode='r:gz') as tar:
        for member in tar.getmembers():
            name = PurePosixPath(member.name)
            require(not name.is_absolute() and '..' not in name.parts and '\\' not in member.name, 'Unsafe archive path')
            if member.isdir():
                continue
            require(member.isfile() and str(name) not in sizes, 'Nonregular or duplicate artifact')
            data = tar.extractfile(member).read()
            sizes[str(name)] = dict(bytes=len(data), sha256=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest())

        destination.mkdir()
        for member in tar.getmembers():
            if member.isfile():
                save(destination / member.name, tar.extractfile(member).read())
    write(ROOT / 'transfer-001.json', dict(files=sizes, compressed_bytes=len(raw), job_id=job,
          archive_sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), read_only_estimate=estimate, pre_fetch_disk_check=disk))
    print(json.dumps(dict(files=len(sizes), compressed_bytes=len(raw), job_id=job)))

"""Offline submission, archive and accounting boundaries; no live transport."""
import contextlib
import hashlib
import io
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import tarfile
import tempfile
from types import SimpleNamespace
import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch

import ops
import build_runtime as builder
import preflight


def sdk_record():
    return dict(required=True, installed=True, client_created=False,
                config=dict(connect_timeout=15,read_timeout=180,retries=dict(mode='standard',total_max_attempts=1)))


class TransportAndSubmissionTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_transport_uses_only_socket_and_hard_timeout(self):
        observed = []
        def fake_run(argv, **kwargs):
            observed.append((argv, kwargs))
            return subprocess.CompletedProcess(argv, 0, stdout=b'fake', stderr=b'')
        with patch.object(ops.subprocess, 'run', fake_run), patch.object(ops, 'sha', return_value='a' * 64):
            self.assertEqual(ops.remote('print("fake")', seconds=17, socket=Path('/tmp/test-only.sock')), b'fake')
        argv, kwargs = observed[0]
        self.assertEqual(len(observed), 1)
        self.assertIn('/tmp/test-only.sock', argv)
        self.assertIn('BatchMode=yes', argv)
        self.assertIn('ProxyCommand=false', argv)
        self.assertEqual(kwargs['timeout'], 17)
        self.assertIn('real-repository-growth-001/execution-001', argv[-1])

    def test_absent_or_stale_authorization_stops_before_transport_or_intent(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
            root = Path(temp)
            with patch.object(ops, 'ROOT', root), patch.object(ops, 'validate_package'), \
                 patch.object(ops, 'validate_authorization', side_effect=ValueError('expired authorization')), \
                 patch.object(ops, 'remote', side_effect=AssertionError('transport reached')):
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'expired'):
                    ops.submit(root / 'authorization.json')
            self.assertFalse((root / 'submissions').exists())

    def test_prior_intent_output_claim_or_ledger_cannot_restart(self):
        for marker in ('model-001', 'startup-failure.json', 'execution.claim.json',
                       'submissions/model.intent.json', 'requests-ledger.json'):
            with self.subTest(marker=marker), tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
                root = Path(temp); path = root / marker
                path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True); path.write_text('prior state')
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    ops.fresh_execution(root)
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
            root = Path(temp); (root/'execution.claim.json').symlink_to(root/'missing-target')
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError): ops.fresh_execution(root)

    def test_private_handoff_is_metadata_only_and_rejects_unsafe_modes_or_links(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
            key = Path(temp) / 'synthetic-private'; key.write_bytes(b'FAKE-NOT-A-CREDENTIAL')
            key.chmod(0o600)
            with patch.object(Path, 'open', side_effect=AssertionError('content read')):
                result = ops.private_handoff_metadata(key)
            self.assertFalse(result['content_read'])
            key.chmod(0o644)
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError): ops.private_handoff_metadata(key)
            key.chmod(0o600); link = Path(temp) / 'link'; link.symlink_to(key)
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError): ops.private_handoff_metadata(link)

    def test_partition_must_be_shared_nonpreemptible_up_and_four_hours(self):
        good = 'PartitionName=shared MaxTime=04:00:00 State=UP PreemptMode=OFF'
        self.assertEqual(ops.partition_seconds(good), 14400)
        self.assertIsNone(ops.partition_seconds(good.replace('04:00:00', 'UNLIMITED')))
        for bad in (good.replace('04:00:00', '03:59:59'), good.replace('OFF', 'CANCEL'),
                    good.replace('UP', 'DOWN'), good.replace('shared', 'test'),
                    good.replace('04:00:00', 'UNKNOWN')):
            with self.subTest(value=bad), self.assertRaises(ValueError): ops.partition_seconds(bad)

    def test_matching_queue_refuses_changed_job_name_or_directory(self):
        for row in ('12|/runtime|other-name|RUNNING', '12|/other|' + ops.JOB_NAME + '|PENDING'):
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError): ops.no_matching_queue(row, Path('/runtime'))
        ops.no_matching_queue('12|/unrelated|unrelated|RUNNING', Path('/runtime'))
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError): ops.no_matching_queue('bad listing', Path('/runtime'))

    def test_ambiguous_submit_keeps_intent_and_no_second_transport(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
            root = Path(temp); authorization = root / 'explicit.json'; authorization.write_text('{}')
            with patch.object(ops, 'ROOT', root), patch.object(ops, 'validate_package'), \
                 patch.object(ops, 'validate_authorization'), patch.object(ops, 'sha', return_value='a' * 64), \
                 patch.object(ops, 'remote', side_effect=subprocess.TimeoutExpired('synthetic', 1)) as transport:
                with self.assertRaises(subprocess.TimeoutExpired): ops.submit(authorization)
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'Existing submission'): ops.submit(authorization)
            self.assertEqual(transport.call_count, 1)
            self.assertTrue((root / 'submissions/model.intent.json').exists())
            self.assertTrue((root / 'submissions/model.transport-failure.json').exists())

    def test_failed_sbatch_receipt_is_preserved_and_cannot_retry(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
            root = Path(temp); authorization = root / 'explicit.json'; authorization.write_text('{}')
            receipt = dict(returncode=1, stdout='', stderr='synthetic scheduler rejection')
            with patch.object(ops, 'ROOT', root), patch.object(ops, 'validate_package'), \
                 patch.object(ops, 'validate_authorization'), patch.object(ops, 'sha', return_value='a' * 64), \
                 patch.object(ops, 'remote', return_value=json.dumps(receipt).encode()) as transport, \
                 contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'failed or ambiguous'): ops.submit(authorization)
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'Existing submission'): ops.submit(authorization)
            self.assertEqual(transport.call_count, 1)
            self.assertEqual(json.loads((root / 'submissions/model.json').read_bytes()), receipt)

def accounting(*rows):
    header='|'.join(ops.ACCOUNTING_FIELDS)
    return header+'\n'+''.join(job+'|'+state+'|00:00:01|1|0:0|1|00:00:01|1|1K|fake-node\n'
                              for job,state in rows)


class TerminalAccountingTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_each_explicit_terminal_parent_state_is_admitted(self):
        for state in ops.TERMINAL_STATES:
            with self.subTest(state=state):
                result=ops.terminal_accounting(accounting(('12345',state)), '12345')
                self.assertTrue(result['all_relevant_rows_terminal'])
                self.assertEqual(result['rows'][0]['normalized_state'],state)

    def test_normal_display_suffixes_are_normalized(self):
        result=ops.terminal_accounting(accounting(('12345','CANCELLED by 4567'),
                    ('12345.batch','CANCELLED+'),('12345.extern','COMPLETED+'),
                    ('12345.0','CANCELLED by 4567+')), '12345')
        self.assertEqual([r['normalized_state'] for r in result['rows']],
                         ['CANCELLED','CANCELLED','COMPLETED','CANCELLED'])

    def test_missing_and_duplicate_exact_parent_fail_closed(self):
        for rows in [(('123450','COMPLETED'),), (('12345.batch','COMPLETED'),),
                     (('12345','COMPLETED'),('12345','COMPLETED'))]:
            with self.subTest(rows=rows), self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'parent'):
                ops.terminal_accounting(accounting(*rows),'12345')

    def test_similar_prefixes_cannot_replace_parent_or_become_its_steps(self):
        raw=accounting(('12345','COMPLETED'),('12345.batch','COMPLETED'),
                       ('123450','RUNNING'),('123450.batch','SUSPENDED'),
                       ('912345','UNKNOWN'),('12345_0','PENDING'))
        result=ops.terminal_accounting(raw,'12345')
        self.assertEqual([r['job_id'] for r in result['rows']],['12345','12345.batch'])
        self.assertEqual(result['ignored_job_ids'],['123450','123450.batch','912345','12345_0'])

    def test_live_unknown_and_requeue_parent_states_fail_closed(self):
        for state in ('SUSPENDED','STOPPED','RUNNING','PENDING','COMPLETING','CONFIGURING',
                      'REQUEUED','REQUEUE_HOLD','SIGNALING','STAGE_OUT','SPECIAL_EXIT','FUTURE_STATE'):
            with self.subTest(state=state), self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'Nonterminal or unknown'):
                ops.terminal_accounting(accounting(('12345',state)),'12345')

    def test_live_or_unknown_step_blocks_terminal_parent(self):
        for ident in ('12345.batch','12345.extern','12345.0'):
            for state in ('RUNNING','SUSPENDED','STOPPED','UNKNOWN'):
                with self.subTest(ident=ident,state=state), self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'Nonterminal or unknown'):
                    ops.terminal_accounting(accounting(('12345','COMPLETED'),(ident,state)),'12345')

    def test_duplicate_step_and_malformed_relevant_step_fail_closed(self):
        for rows in [(('12345','COMPLETED'),('12345.batch','COMPLETED'),('12345.batch','COMPLETED')),
                     (('12345','COMPLETED'),('12345.','COMPLETED')),
                     (('12345','COMPLETED'),('12345..batch','COMPLETED'))]:
            with self.subTest(rows=rows), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                ops.terminal_accounting(accounting(*rows),'12345')

    def test_unknown_suffix_or_truncated_base_is_never_guessed(self):
        for state in ('OUT_OF_ME+','COMPLETED unexpected','COMPLETED by 7','CANCELLED by user',
                      'CANCELLED+++','COMPLETED+RUNNING',''):
            with self.subTest(state=state), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                ops.terminal_accounting(accounting(('12345',state)),'12345')

    def test_missing_header_malformed_rows_and_bad_parent_identifiers_rejected(self):
        for text in ('', 'JobID|State\n12345|COMPLETED\n',
                     accounting(('12345','COMPLETED'))+'12345.batch|COMPLETED\n'):
            with self.subTest(text=text), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                ops.terminal_accounting(text,'12345')
        for job in ('12345.batch','12345_0','012345','',12345):
            with self.subTest(job=job), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                ops.terminal_accounting(accounting(('12345','COMPLETED')),job)


class ActualRemoteProgramTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setup_roots(self):
        temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(); self.addCleanup(temp.cleanup)
        base = Path(temp.name); local = base / 'local'; remote = base / 'remote'
        for root in (local, remote):
            root.mkdir(); (root / 'submissions').mkdir()
            code = root / 'repo' / ops.REL; code.mkdir(parents=True)
            freeze = json.dumps(dict(schema='repodisco-growth-execution-runtime-v1', repo_files={})).encode()
            for destination in (root / 'runtime-freeze.json', code / 'runtime-freeze.json'):
                destination.write_bytes(freeze)
            for destination in (root / 'run.sbatch', code / 'run.sbatch'):
                destination.write_bytes(b'#!/bin/bash\n# synthetic fixture\n')
        return local, remote

    def execute_remote(self, code, root, data=None, query=None, run=None):
        output = io.BytesIO()
        class Output:
            buffer = output
            def write(self, value): output.write(value.encode())
            def flush(self): pass
        code = code.replace('EXPECTED_RUNTIME', repr(ops.sha(root / 'runtime-freeze.json')))
        stdin = SimpleNamespace(buffer=io.BytesIO(data or b''))
        with patch.object(subprocess, 'check_output', query or (lambda *a, **k: '')), \
             patch.object(sys, 'stdout', Output()), patch.object(sys, 'stdin', stdin), \
             patch.object(sys, 'path', list(sys.path)):
            if run is not None:
                with patch.object(subprocess, 'run', run):
                    exec(compile(code, '<synthetic-remote>', 'exec'), {'root': root, 'Path': Path})
            else:
                exec(compile(code, '<synthetic-remote>', 'exec'), {'root': root, 'Path': Path})
        return output.getvalue()

    def test_remote_submit_checks_live_partition_and_writes_one_receipt(self):
        local, remote = self.setup_roots(); calls = []
        (remote / 'remote-preflight-001.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(returncode=0, runtime_sha256=ops.sha(remote/'runtime-freeze.json'), sdk=sdk_record())))
        auth = dict(authorized_runtime_root=str(remote), output_relative_path='model-001')
        import runtime
        def query(argv, **kwargs):
            self.assertEqual(kwargs['timeout'], 15)
            if argv[0] == 'squeue': return ''
            self.assertEqual(argv, ['scontrol','show','partition','shared'])
            return 'PartitionName=shared MaxTime=1-00:00:00 State=UP PreemptMode=OFF'
        def submit(argv, **kwargs):
            calls.append(argv); self.assertEqual(kwargs['timeout'], 25)
            return subprocess.CompletedProcess(argv, 0, stdout='12345;cluster\n', stderr='')
        with patch.object(runtime, 'validate_package'), patch.object(runtime, 'validate_authorization', return_value=auth), \
             patch.object(ops, 'private_handoff_metadata', return_value=dict(content_read=False)):
            raw = self.execute_remote(ops.SUBMIT, remote, json.dumps(auth).encode(), query=query, run=submit)
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'Existing submission'):
                self.execute_remote(ops.SUBMIT, remote, json.dumps(auth).encode(), query=query, run=submit)
        self.assertEqual(calls, [['sbatch','--parsable','--partition=shared','run.sbatch']])
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(raw)['job_id'], '12345')
        self.assertEqual((remote/'authorization.json').read_bytes(), json.dumps(auth).encode())
        self.assertTrue((remote/'submissions/model.lock').exists())

    def test_remote_wrong_root_authorization_rejected_before_handoff_or_sbatch(self):
        local, remote = self.setup_roots()
        (remote / 'remote-preflight-001.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(returncode=0, runtime_sha256=ops.sha(remote/'runtime-freeze.json'), sdk=sdk_record())))
        import runtime
        with patch.object(runtime, 'validate_package'), \
             patch.object(runtime, 'validate_authorization', return_value=dict(authorized_runtime_root='/wrong', output_relative_path='model-001')), \
             patch.object(ops, 'private_handoff_metadata', side_effect=AssertionError('handoff reached')) as key:
            with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
                self.execute_remote(ops.SUBMIT, remote, b'{}')
        self.assertEqual(key.call_count, 0)
        self.assertFalse((remote/'submissions/model.lock').exists())

    def fake_fetch(self, raw):
        local, remote = self.setup_roots()
        (local/'submissions/model.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(job_id='12345')))
        for name in ('submissions/model.lock','submissions/model.json','authorization.json','remote-preflight-001.json'):
            (remote/name).write_text('{}')
        (remote/'model-001').mkdir()
        (remote/'model-001/evidence.txt').write_text('synthetic saved evidence')
        (remote/'model-001/archive-manifest.json').write_text('{}')
        target = remote/'model-001/slot-01/native/fresh-target'; target.mkdir(parents=True)
        (target/'generated-cache').write_text('not evidence')
        captured = []
        def query(argv, **kwargs):
            self.assertEqual(argv[:3], ['sacct','-j','12345'])
            self.assertIn('State%80', argv[3]); self.assertEqual(kwargs['timeout'], 15)
            return raw
        def transport(code, data=None, seconds=45, socket=None):
            result = self.execute_remote(code, remote, data, query=query)
            captured.append(result); return result
        def run(free=1024*1024*1024):
            with patch.object(ops, 'ROOT', local), patch.object(ops, 'remote', transport), \
                 patch.object(ops.shutil, 'disk_usage', return_value=SimpleNamespace(free=free)), \
                 contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()): ops.fetch()
        return run, local, remote, captured

    def test_terminal_fetch_preserves_logs_and_excludes_only_fixed_scratch(self):
        raw = accounting(('12345','COMPLETED'),('12345.batch','COMPLETED'))
        run, local, remote, captured = self.fake_fetch(raw); run()
        self.assertEqual(len(captured), 2)
        retrieved = local/'retrieved-001'
        self.assertEqual((retrieved/'accounting.txt').read_text(), raw)
        self.assertTrue((retrieved/'model-001/evidence.txt').exists())
        self.assertTrue((retrieved/'model-001/archive-manifest.json').exists())
        self.assertFalse((retrieved/'model-001/slot-01/native/fresh-target').exists())
        self.assertTrue((remote/'model-001/slot-01/native/fresh-target/generated-cache').exists())
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(captured[0])['excluded_scratch_directories'], ['model-001/slot-01/native/fresh-target'])
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'Already fetched'): run()

    def test_live_step_prevents_accounting_and_archive_mutation(self):
        run, local, remote, captured = self.fake_fetch(accounting(('12345','COMPLETED'),('12345.batch','SUSPENDED')))
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'Nonterminal or unknown'): run()
        self.assertEqual(captured, [])
        self.assertFalse((remote/'accounting.txt').exists())
        self.assertFalse((local/'retrieved-001').exists())

    def test_insufficient_space_only_performs_read_only_estimate(self):
        run, local, remote, captured = self.fake_fetch(accounting(('12345','COMPLETED')))
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'Insufficient local disk'): run(64*1024*1024)
        self.assertEqual(len(captured), 1)
        self.assertFalse((remote/'accounting.txt').exists())
        self.assertFalse((local/'retrieved-001').exists())

    def test_unrecognized_cache_path_is_evidence_and_symlinks_are_rejected(self):
        run, local, remote, captured = self.fake_fetch(accounting(('12345','COMPLETED')))
        other = remote/'model-001/slot-09/native/fresh-target'; other.mkdir(parents=True)
        (other/'important.txt').write_text('not an allowed exclusion')
        broken = remote/'model-001/source-link'; broken.symlink_to(other/'important.txt')
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'Symlink|Nonregular'): run()
        broken.unlink(); run()
        self.assertTrue((local/'retrieved-001/model-001/slot-09/native/fresh-target/important.txt').exists())
